The '''Model 67 Shrieker''' was a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] that was fast, lightweight and very maneuverable.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Micahonspeeder.jpg|thumb|left|200px]]

Designed by [[Ikas-Adno/Legends|Ikas-Adno]], it resembled the earlier [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It had a pair of forward directional steering vanes and a variable boost [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engine. It also had an advanced repulsor field generation system that allowed for rapid altitude changes. It had an elongated seat which gave room for one passenger.<ref name="LECG" />

It was named for the characteristic screech its engines made when at full throttle. It was favored by pilots who preferred speed over protection. The Shrieker was made with common parts, and was very easy to maintain or modify.<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
The Model 67 Shrieker was popular on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] due to its low price and ease of operation. Bantha Rawk owned several Model 67s and his children rode them during a [[Skirmish on Iego|fight]] with [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] operatives on Iego.<ref name="LECG" />
